summary.en: Led school computer club programming division, coordinating training programs and member development initiatives.
summary.id: Memimpin divisi pemrograman klub komputer sekolah, mengkoordinasikan program pelatihan dan inisiatif pengembangan anggota.

achievements.en: Coordinated programming activities and collaborative projects among club members.
achievements.id: Mengkoordinasikan kegiatan pemrograman dan proyek bersama anggota klub.

achievements.en: Developed and executed training programs covering basic to advanced programming concepts.
achievements.id: Menyusun dan menjalankan program pelatihan pemrograman dasar hingga lanjutan.

achievements.en: Mentored members in project development and problem-solving skill enhancement.
achievements.id: Membimbing anggota dalam pengembangan proyek dan peningkatan kemampuan problem solving.

achievements.en: Presented project results at school events to promote collaboration and innovation.
achievements.id: Mempresentasikan hasil proyek pada kegiatan sekolah untuk mendorong kolaborasi dan inovasi.
